diagnostics.message: :output.custom_role_id: explicit depends_on of :resource.google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles is redundant — already implied by attribute references

google_tags_tag_key.default can have IAM bindings (via google_tags_tag_key_iam_binding.default) whose roles are organization custom roles created by google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles (e.g. 'organizations/123/roles/myRole'). The tag key already carries an explicit depends_on on the other organization IAM resources, but not on the custom role resource, so a tag-key IAM binding referencing a custom role could be applied before the role exists. The custom role must be created first.

The depends_on on google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles in output.custom_role_id is redundant: the output's value already iterates over google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles (the for_each expression references it), which establishes the same dependency implicitly.
